notesStmt.note: These draft lines contributed to the poem "You Tides with Ceaseless Swell," first published with seven other poems in the August 1885 issue of Nineteenth Century under the collective title "Fancies at Navesink." The sequence was later reprinted in November Boughs (1888).
This manuscript was probably created in late 1884 or in 1885.
